details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that beacons to a callback host at install time. Its package.json postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, which sends an HTTP POST of JSON {package, hostname, installPath, cwd, userAgent, protocol} to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an `x-beacon-package` header; index.js fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a no-op Proxy so importing code does not crash. The package collects only host and install-location metadata — no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or transmitted. The README self-describes the package as an authorized dependency-confusion test.
